phone.requested: Request accepted. SMS delivery is currently being fixed on our side, so the code may not arrive. If nothing arrives, try again later.

setup.title: Get Ready for Your Interview
setup.subtitle: Check your setup and review the recording requirements before starting.
setup.desktopTitle: Please open InternsHub on your laptop to continue.
setup.desktopBody: The recorded interview is available on desktop or laptop only.
setup.connectionDesc: A stable connection helps prevent interruption
setup.connectionOnline: Your device reports a network connection. This doesn't test the interview service.
setup.connectionOffline: Your device reports no network connection. Reconnect before you start.
setup.consentBody: InternsHub records camera, microphone, and shared screen during the interview. Recordings are deleted 90 days after the final decision; scores and transcripts are retained.
setup.incompleteValue: Retake after 48 hours, subject to attempt rules
setup.attemptLimitValue: Three per track and interview type, then admin review
setup.durationNote: Interview duration and question count are intentionally not shown because they remain open business decisions.
setup.startHint: To start, get your camera, microphone and entire-screen sharing ready and give your consent.

overview.title: AI Interview
overview.subtitle: Review the requirements below and begin your session when you are ready.
overview.readyTechnical: This AI assessment will evaluate your level in the selected track.
overview.readyOrientation: This AI assessment will review how well the selected track fits you.
overview.environmentTitle: Ensure a quiet environment and stable connection.
overview.environmentBody: Your camera, microphone and full-screen sharing must stay active for the whole interview.
overview.readyBody: Continue when you are ready to review the recording consent.
overview.desktopDesc: A recent Chrome, Edge, Firefox or Safari on a laptop or desktop
overview.cameraDesc: Your camera is recorded during the interview
overview.screenDesc: Share your entire screen, not a window or tab

consent.title: Recording Consent
consent.subtitle: Review how your interview will be recorded before continuing.
consent.noticeTitle: During your AI interview, your camera and shared screen will be recorded.
consent.noticeBody: Your spoken answers will also be transcribed and assessed as part of the interview.
consent.recordingDesc: Your camera and shared screen are recorded during the interview.
consent.transcriptionDesc: Your spoken answers are transcribed and scored as part of the assessment.
consent.retentionDesc: Interview recordings are deleted 90 days after the final decision. Scores and transcripts are retained.
consent.checkbox: I consent to the recording of my camera, screen, and interview audio for assessment and review.
consent.required: Consent is required before starting the interview.

deviceCheck.title: Device Check
deviceCheck.subtitle: Make sure your camera, microphone, and full-screen sharing are ready before starting your interview.
deviceCheck.previewOff: Your camera preview appears here after the check.
deviceCheck.speakHint: Speak briefly to test your microphone.
deviceCheck.screenHint: Share your entire screen to continue.
deviceCheck.surfaceUnknown: Your browser doesn't report what was shared. Make sure you chose your entire screen.
deviceCheck.requirementsNote: These must remain active throughout the interview. If one stops, the interview will pause until it is restored.

session.question: Question {{number}}
session.answeringBody: Your answer is recorded from your microphone while the question is shown. Select Done when you have finished.
session.answerSavedBody: Your answer was sent to the interview. Continue when you are ready.
session.endedBody: Thank you. Your answers have been sent.
session.pausedBody: A required device has stopped. Restore it to continue the interview.
session.copyDisabled: Copying, cutting and pasting are turned off in the question area during the interview.
session.answerKept: Your recorded answer is kept. Send it again, or record a new answer.

call.speakNaturally: Speak naturally into your microphone. Click Done when finished to submit your spoken answer.

fullscreen.noticeBody: When you select {{action}}, the interview fills your screen and the browser hides its tabs and toolbars. If you leave fullscreen during the questions, for example with Esc, the question is hidden and the interview pauses until you return.
fullscreen.unsupportedTitle: Fullscreen isn't available in this browser
fullscreen.unsupportedBody: The interview will continue in a normal browser window.
fullscreen.requestFailedBody: Your browser didn't switch to fullscreen, so the interview hasn't started. Select {{action}} to try again. If it keeps happening, allow fullscreen for this site in your browser settings, or use another desktop browser.
fullscreen.warningBody: Please return to fullscreen to continue the interview. The question is hidden and the interview is paused until you do.
fullscreen.restoreFailed: Fullscreen didn't start. Please select Return to fullscreen again.

errors.recordingUnsupported: This browser can't record audio from your microphone. Use a recent version of Chrome, Edge or Firefox.
errors.emptyRecording: No sound was recorded. Check your microphone, answer again and select Done.
errors.recordingFailed: Recording stopped unexpectedly. Check that your microphone is connected, then try recording again.

result.previewHint: Sample states. The real outcome will come from the interview service.

underReview.progressBody: You'll be notified when your final result is available.
underReview.note: You can check your interview status here later.

resume.title: Resume Interview

resume.availableBody: You can resume this interview within {{hours}} hour of the interruption.
resume.note: You'll repeat the device check, then continue from question {{number}}.

cannotResume.subtitle: This interview attempt has been closed as incomplete.
cannotResume.retakeBody: You can start a new interview attempt after the waiting period has elapsed.
cannotResume.note: Your previous attempt will remain marked as incomplete.

orientation.title: AI Interview
orientation.subtitle: Review your orientation result and next step.
orientation.resultBody: Your selected track appears to be a good fit.
orientation.advisoryBody: You can still continue with your selected track.

appeal.reasonLabel: Why would you like this result reviewed?

appeal.reasonRequired: Enter a reason to submit your appeal.
appeal.reviewerTitle: Your appeal will be reviewed by a different reviewer.

appeal.notSent: Preview only: appeals are not sent anywhere yet.

submitted.title: Appeal Submitted

submitted.final: The appeal decision will be final.

decision.unchangedNote: Your interview level stays the same following the appeal review.
